raw:
{
  "type": "rule",
  "call": "Incomplete pass. The receiver must have firm control when the first body part touches the ground inbounds; bobbling means no firm control, so securing it out of bounds does not make a catch.",
  "foul": false,
  "penalty_yards": null,
  "enforcement_spot": null,
  "rules": ["A.R. 2-4-3", "A.R. 7-3-6"],
  "quote": "A88 gains firm control of the ball with toes down inbounds, bobbles the ball while airborne, regains firm control before landing out of bounds and maintains firm control when landing. RULING: Incomplete pass.",
  "explanation": "Under A.R. 2-4-3 IV(b), a receiver who gets a foot down inbounds while bobbling the ball has not established firm control at the moment of initial contact with the ground. The catch is not completed until the player maintains firm control through the process of going to the ground. Securing the ball only after that point, while going out of bounds, results in an incomplete pass.",
  "needs_review": false
}
